instruction: Set the GNOME cursor theme to Adwaita by modifying the desktop interface settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing cursor theme to Adwaita through GNOME settings interface. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify cursor-theme is set to 'Adwaita'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface cursor-theme' to extract the cursor theme setting, which is the standard and correct method for verifying GNOME desktop settings
The check_list metric with regex pattern 'Adwaita' will successfully match the gsettings output format (e.g., 'Adwaita'), as the regex searches for the substring anywhere in the output
Complete coverage: The evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (setting cursor theme to Adwaita)
Data flow is correct: postconfig executes command → cache_file getter reads output → check_list metric searches for 'Adwaita' pattern → returns 1.0 if found
No edge case issues: gsettings command is reliable and will always return a value for the cursor-theme setting
